headline.purpose: Page titles only (Applicants, Finance, Reconciliation). One per screen.

title.purpose: Section headers within a page: drawer headings, card-group titles.

label.purpose: Form labels, table headers, nav items, button text.

body.purpose: Default text: table cells, paragraph copy, drawer body.

mono.purpose: Every money amount, ID, timestamp, and count -- tabular numerals on.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Hairline separator between the nav/header plane and content. The default elevation state for 95% of the interface.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: The applicant-detail drawer sliding in over content -- the one real elevation in the system.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Double ring (white gap + cobalt ring) on every keyboard-focusable element.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Strong ease-out for button press, nav hover, and the drawer's own entrance -- carried forward from the v1 redesign's motion research, unchanged by this pass.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per screen -- Sign in, Apply transition, Upload.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #005681; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; font: 500 13px/1.4 Geist, -apple-system, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #004573; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #003a5f; transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #005681; outline: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every non-primary action: Logout, Cancel, secondary filters.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #f3f8fa; color: #0c181d; padding: 8px 16px; font: 500 13px/1.4 Geist, -apple-system, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ebf1f4; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field -- login email/password, applicant filters.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #0c181d; border: 1px solid #d9dfe2; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 14px/1.5 Geist, -apple-system, sans-serif; transition: border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #58666d; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #005681; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #005681; outline: none; }

components.name: Nav Item (Active)
components.description: The current section in the sidebar -- Harbor Cobalt Subtle background, the one place navigation earns the brand color.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 13px/1.4 Geist, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #0c181d; text-decoration: none; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #ebf1f4; } .ds-nav-item--active, .ds-nav-item--active:hover { background: #e5f3fa; color: #005681; }

components.name: Status Chip (Fog Amber)
components.description: The one reserved role for the brand's secondary hue -- a flagged row, a note requiring review. Never used for a primary action.
components.css: .ds-chip-amber { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #feebd6; color: #6c3a00; font: 500 12px/1.3 Geist, -apple-system, sans-serif; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Empty State
components.description: The signature component this redesign pass adds: a composed icon + headline + body inside a Steel Surface card, used on every list/table screen that can be legitimately empty.
components.css: .ds-empty-state { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; background: #f3f8fa; border-radius: 12px; padding: 40px; gap: 8px; } .ds-empty-icon { margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-empty-title { font: 600 18px/1.3 Geist, -apple-system, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #0c181d; margin: 0; } .ds-empty-body { font: 400 14px/1.5 Geist, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #58666d; margin: 0; max-width: 42ch; }

narrative.overview: Sirius runs like the office of a harbor master at dawn: cold steel water, fog-muted light, the quiet before the boats leave. Every entry in the ledger is checked twice, every signature is attributable, and nothing is decorative -- the room exists to get the count right, not to impress a visitor. The deep cobalt of pre-dawn water is the only color the interface volunteers on its own; everything else is neutral until a real state (a status, an error, a selection) earns it. This system explicitly rejects the SaaS-marketing-dashboard costume: no hero sections, no gradient-text metrics, no confetti on save. It also rejects the two failure modes of the redesign that preceded it -- Mantine's stock default blue with a teal accent swapped in, and, before that, completely unstyled defaults. Sirius is closer to a bank branch's teller system or a university bursar's ledger than to a startup dashboard: it has been doing this exact job for years and it shows in the confidence of the restraint, not in visual noise.
keyCharacteristics: One brand color (deep cobalt), used sparingly and only where it means something -- primary actions, current navigation, links, focus rings.
A dense, tabular-numeral, fixed-rem type scale built for real data, not a fluid marketing scale.
Flat by default; elevation appears only where it communicates real hierarchy (the navigation drawer over content, a modal over the page).
Semantic status colors (applicant pipeline stages, payment-claim states) are a separate vocabulary from the one brand accent, so the two never collide or get mistaken for each other.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Harbor Cobalt appears exactly once per screen as a rule of thumb: the single primary action, or the single active nav item, or a focus ring -- never as a background wash, never twice competing for attention in the same view.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: No clamp(), no fluid viewport-based sizing anywhere in this system. Users view a data-dense tool at a consistent desktop DPI; a fluid headline that shrinks in a sidebar reads as broken, not responsive.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: A card, panel, or shadow must justify its existence by separating two things a user could otherwise confuse. A card wrapped around content that would read identically without it is a Don't.

dos: Do use Harbor Cobalt (#005681) exactly once per screen as the single primary signal -- a button, an active nav item, a focus ring.
Do render every money/ID/timestamp/count in Geist Mono with tabular numerals so columns of numbers align.
Do compose a real empty state (icon + headline + one line of body text, inside a Steel Surface card) for every screen that can be legitimately empty.
Do keep the existing semantic status-badge vocabulary completely separate from the one brand accent.
Do verify every role gate, RLS-scoped view, and maker-checker control renders identically in behavior before and after this pass.
donts: Don't use Mantine's stock default blue, or any AI-purple accent.
Don't use a warm-cream/beige surface anywhere; the neutral ramp stays cool-tinted toward the primary's own cobalt hue.
Don't wrap list rows, form sections, or anything a hairline divider already separates in a card.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on any element.
Don't use clamp() or fluid viewport-based type sizing anywhere.
Don't ship a bare 'No results' text row as an empty state -- every empty state gets the full composed treatment.
